dct_title_s: Carte generale de L'Afrique contenent les principaux etats qui y sont contenuë dressée sur les nouvelles observations
dct_description_sm: Twenty-nine coats of arms, representing the major cities of Europe, surround the cartouche; Prime meridian through Ferro Island and Paris.

Norwich, I., Pam Kolbe, and Jeffrey C Stone. Norwich's Maps of Africa: An Illustrated and Annotated Carto-Bibliography. 2nd ed. / rev. and edited by Jeffrey C. Stone. Norwich, Vt.: Terra Nova Press, 1997. Map 0082, p. 97.
David Rumsey Map Center copy 1: Norwich no. NOR 0082.
